title: Verify Video Auto-Play on Page Load
description: Verify that video auto-plays when navigating to a song page with Fluid mode enabled.

testSetup.clearBrowserData: Use incognito or clear site data to test fresh user experience

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start dev server if not running: bun run dev
Wait 3 seconds for page to fully load
Take screenshot - verify video is NOT blurry (either playing or has play overlay)
Check if video is playing OR if there's a clear 'Click to play' button visible
If play overlay exists, click it
Take screenshot after 2 seconds - verify video is now playing (not blurry)
Verify Fluid mode button is selected/active
Verify lines are highlighting and advancing automatically
Watch for 5 seconds - confirm lines continue to advance with video
Take final screenshot showing video playing and a line highlighted
Use mcp__browser-tools__getConsoleErrors - verify no autoplay-related errors blocking playback
Test Single mode still works: click Single button, click a line, verify it plays once and stops
Test Loop mode still works: click Loop button, click a line, verify it loops

blockedBy: Video serving infrastructure issue: TanStack Start + Nitro returns intermittent 503 errors for /video/baraye/baraye.mp4 when loaded via <video> tag. Video works when accessed directly in browser. This is a server-side Range request handling issue affecting all video playback.
